title: Closed lowest-cohomology locus of a supplied affine finite-free complex
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-affine-spectrum], $K$ a bounded-above cochain complex of module sheaves on $X$ [def-pc-derived-category], and $a\in\mathbf Z$. Suppose $K^j=0$ for $j<a$, every term is finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module], and $K^a\cong\mathcal O_X^{\oplus s}$ for natural numbers $s\leq r$. Then there exists a closed immersion $i:Z\to X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], such that for every scheme $T$ and morphism $h:T\to X$, a factorization of $h$ through $i$ exists if and only if $H^a(Lh^*(QK))$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is finite locally free of rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. This concerns the supplied affine complex; it asserts no existence of a residue model or open neighbourhood.

source.place: local matrix calculation (with Tag 0EWY), before gluing

proof.text: The bounded-above finite-free complex is a bounded-above flat complex. Termwise tensor pullback computes its derived pullback. Zero terms below a stay zero, so its lowest cohomology is the kernel of the pulled-back outgoing degree-a differential.

When s=r, choose finite free frames for degrees a and a+1 and form the ideal in Gamma(X,O_X) generated by the finitely many matrix entries. Its quotient spectrum gives a closed subscheme of X. A map factors through it exactly when the pulled-back matrix vanishes. If the kernel is locally free of rank r, trivialize it on affine source neighbourhoods. Its square injective inclusion has cokernel with zero dual by 0EWY, so each coordinate of the outgoing map, which factors through that cokernel, is zero. Conversely the kernel of a zero matrix is the free first term. The local factors agree by monomorphy of the closed immersion.

When s<r, use the empty closed subscheme. On any nonempty affine source neighbourhood, a rank-r kernel would inject into the rank-s first term. Pad the latter with r-s zero coordinates; the resulting square injection has injective transpose by 0EWY, but the transpose annihilates a nonzero padded basis vector. Thus the source must be empty; on the empty source both predicates hold.

The matrix ideal is finitely generated. RingHom.FinitePresentation.of_surjective and LocallyOfFinitePresentation.SpecMap_iff give local finite presentation of its quotient immersion. The empty immersion is likewise finitely presented, using the unit ideal. For s=r=0, the zero matrix cuts out all of X. Empty schemes and zero rings are included.

proof_origin.note: Isolates one strictly structural part of the local chart argument. Edge cases: empty schemes, rank zero and reversed Tor bounds are included.

theorem exists_affineFreeLowestMatrixLocus
    [∀ T : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine X]
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (a : ℤ) (s r : ℕ) (hsr : s ≤ r)
    (hbounded : ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, c < j → IsZero (K.X j))
    (hlower : ∀ j : ℤ, j < a → IsZero (K.X j))
    (hfree : ∀ j : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (K.X j ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n))))
    (ha : Nonempty (K.X a ≅ SheafOfModules.free
      (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin s)))) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X),
      IsClosedImmersion i ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation i ∧
      (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (h : T ⟶ X),
        (∃ g : T ⟶ Z, g ≫ i = h) ↔
          SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u}
            ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
                ((derivedPullback h).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))) r)
